english.title: Registered person fail to notify Commission of death of a service user
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission failed to notify the Commission without delay of the death of a service user

(A)_[whilst services were being provided in the]_
(B)_[which had, or may have, resulted from]_

the carrying on of a regulated activity namely **(..SPECIFY REGULATED ACTIVITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 16(3) states that when notifying the Commission, the registered person must include a description of the circumstances of the death.
(ii) Regulation 16(4) states that the death does not have to be reported to the Commission when it has already been reported to the National Patient Safety Agency.
(iii) The offence will not apply when the death which took place was of a service user who was liable to be detained under the Mental Health Act 1983 or pursuant to an order / direction which takes effect as if the order / direction had been made pursuant to the 1983 Act.
